verdict.rationale: Cake documents the individual pieces of this workflow — fast board sign-offs/e-signing (docs-10), NSO/ISO option issuance with vesting (docs-4, docs-5), and an included 409A valuation delivered within 3 business days (docs-20) — but no evidence describes these as chained into a single end-to-end 'issue options to a new hire' workflow that pulls a live 409A strike price directly into a board approval and grant issuance step. missing for 10: explicit documentation that the 409A price auto-populates the option grant, a walkthrough of the new-hire grant flow tying board approval, strike price, and issuance together, and independent/hands-on confirmation.
